```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggunc)
library(ggspatial)
```

```{r}

DATA_PATH = Sys.getenv("DATA_PATH")
blocks = read_sf(file.path(DATA_PATH, "data", "hu.gpkg"))
links = read_sf(file.path(DATA_PATH, "data", "links.gpkg"))

```

```{r}
all_top250_files = Sys.glob(file.path(DATA_PATH, "networks", "links_top250", "*", "disaggregate.csv"))
stopifnot(length(all_top250_files) == 250)
```

```{r}
top250 = map(all_top250_files, \(x) (read_csv(x, col_types = cols(id = col_character()), show_col_types = F) |> mutate(link = as.numeric(str_extract(x, "link_id_([0-9]+)", group = 1))))) |>
    list_rbind()

base = read_csv(file.path(DATA_PATH, "networks", "baseline", "disaggregate.csv"), col_types = cols(id = col_character()))
```

```{r}
top250 = top250 |>
    left_join(base, join_by(id), relationship = "many-to-one", suffix = c("_link", "_base")) |>
    mutate(accessibility_delta = accessibility_link - accessibility_base, accessibility_pctchg = accessibility_link / accessibility_base)
```

```{r}
max_access_increase = top250 |>
    group_by(link) |>
    summarize(max_abs = max(accessibility_delta))

max_access_increase |>
    ggplot(aes(x = max_abs)) +
        geom_histogram() +
        xlab("Largest job access increase\n(jobs within 60 minutes)") +
        ylab("") +
        scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
        annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf(
            "Mean: %s\n25th percentile: %s\nMedian: %s\n75th percentile: %s",
            scales::comma(round(mean(max_access_increase$max_abs))),
            scales::comma(round(quantile(max_access_increase$max_abs, 0.25))),
            scales::comma(round(median(max_access_increase$max_abs))),
            scales::comma(round(quantile(max_access_increase$max_abs, 0.75)))
        ), hjust=1.1, vjust=1.2)

ggsave(here::here("paper/figures/top250.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

Sensitivity test medians

```{r}
max_access_increase |>
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(links), join_by(link == id)) |>
    filter(rank <= 10) |>
    summarize(median = median(max_abs), n = n())
```

```{r}
max_access_increase |>
    left_join(st_drop_geometry(links), join_by(link == id)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x=rank, y=max_abs)) +
        geom_point()
```

## What about aggregate

```{r}
agg = top250 |>
    left_join(blocks, join_by(id == GEOID)) |>
    group_by(link) |>
    summarize(
        agg = sum(accessibility_link * H1_001N),
        delta = agg - with(base, sum(accessibility * H1_001N))
    )

agg = agg |>
    left_join(links, join_by(link == id))
```

```{r}
agg |>
    ggplot(aes(x = delta)) +
        geom_histogram() +
        xlab("Largest job access increase\n(jobs within 60 minutes)") +
        ylab("") +
        scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
        annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf(
            "Mean: %s\n25th percentile: %s\nMedian: %s\n75th percentile: %s",
            scales::comma(round(mean(agg$delta))),
            scales::comma(round(quantile(agg$delta, 0.25))),
            scales::comma(round(median(agg$delta))),
            scales::comma(round(quantile(agg$delta, 0.75)))
        ), hjust=1.1, vjust=1.2)

ggsave(here::here("paper/figures/top250_agg.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
agg |>
  mutate(
    rankcat = cut(rank, c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, 250))
  ) |>
  group_by(rankcat) |>
  mutate(
    rankcat = fct_relabel(rankcat, \(rankcat) {
      sprintf(
        "%d-%s",
        as.numeric(str_extract(rankcat, "^\\(([0-9]+)", 1)) + 1,
        str_extract(rankcat, "([0-9]+)\\]$", 1)
      )
    })
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = rankcat, y = delta)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  xlab("Access to transit rank") +
  ylab("Median change in access score\n(housing units × jobs accessible)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma)

ggsave(here::here("paper/figures/top250_box.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```

## Evaluate reduced access
```{r}
agg |>
    filter(delta < 0)
```

If you look at top250 there are a few, but that's not surprising.
